summary:
Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by reading and editing files only; no tests or repository code were run, and nothing was committed.

Changes:
- rich/console.py: print() passes justify="default" in render options; justify still goes to _collect_renderables.
- rich/align.py: Align renders its wrapped renderable constrained to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and width); added Align.__repr__; added public VerticalCenter with render (newline-only padding from console.size.height), measurement delegation, and repr.
- rich/tree.py: Tree.__rich_measure__ walks iteratively with an explicit stack and level counter, adding 4 cells per level; imports Measurement.
- CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 heading marked "- Unreleased"; added Added subsection with the two entries; kept the existing STDIN line.
- tests/test_align.py: imports VerticalCenter; adds repr, render (height 6 yields "\n\nfoo\n\n\n"), tall-content, and measure (3, 3) tests.
- tests/test_tree.py: imports Measurement; adds a test expecting Measurement(11, 19) for the example tree.

Not verified: the test suite has not been run, so all new and existing tests are unconfirmed. Running pytest on tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py will confirm them.
